themes.label: 考试与评分
themes.selection: 选课前核对当期考试权重和题型，评估它与同学期其他课程的考试安排。
themes.study: 尽早确认考试范围与题型，复习时做限时练习，不只背熟已有答案。

themes.label: 编程与调试
themes.selection: 如果编程经验较少，为实际写代码和调试留出时间，再评估同修负担。
themes.study: 亲自运行并修改例子，为自己的程序编写小测试，保留调试记录。

evidence.quote: find a research paper about trading strategy--> slightly change the idea --> code it on quantconnect --> paper trading on interactive brokers

themes.label: 课堂参与
themes.selection: 关注当期课堂参与和考勤说明；往届学生的经历不能直接代替本学期要求。
themes.study: 开课时确认参与分与考勤规则，把课堂活动和提交期限记进日历。

themes.label: 阅读与表达
themes.selection: 如果本学期已有多门阅读或汇报课程，先比较各门课的交付时间再组合。
themes.study: 读材料时记录论点和依据；写作或汇报先列提纲，再检查表达与引用。

sections.content:
Attached is the syllabus.

Please note that Andrew is not going to approve any course request from non-QFIN students, as required by the FINA department.

What you do in this course:
find a research paper about trading strategy--> slightly change the idea --> code it on quantconnect --> paper trading on interactive brokers
Eventually, most of the groups are actually losing money in the paper trading >.<
sections.teaching: No comment at all. You can skip all lectures.
sections.grading:
According to the professor, the grade highly depends on the peer evaluation score. I do not have any comment as it is the last semester and I do not mind to get a D grade in this course.

Since it is the last semester, some presentation slides are terrible.
sections.workload: No exam and attendance required. Very low if you are not the one who codes.
